name: Vallcebre (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white fleur-de-lis at the centre and eight white six-pointed stars in the corners and at the middle of each edge.
history: The flag was approved on 21 April 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2048 of 10 May 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, with a white fleur-de-lis of half the height at the centre and eight white stars of major diagonal 1/6, placed in the four corners and at the middle of the four edges, 1/18 from the borders.

features.role: stars in the four corners and at the middle of the four edges
